name: Text contrast stays at or above 4.5:1 in day and dusk, including interactive states
description: Every text and background pair in tokens.json holds 4.5:1 in both themes, and --accent is never used for text.

name: Colour, typography, and spacing come from shared tokens
description: No raw colour values in style code, every font size is a --text-* token, and every letter-spacing is a --tracking-* token or 0.

name: The serif is only for headlines, never under 28px
description: DM Serif Display is never set with a text size under 28px, unless the rule is marked serif-ok with a reason.

name: Buttons use consistent casing and language
description: Button labels are in Title Case, unless a person wrote them, and no page copy has an em dash.

name: Images include alternative text and controls have accessible labels
description: Every image has an alt attribute, and every link and button has a name.

name: Motion follows one system and respects reduced-motion preferences
description: There is a reduced-motion rule, autoplaying video can be paused, and transitions use the duration tokens.

name: Only links and buttons move on hover
description: Anything that lifts or slides on hover is a link or a button.

name: Phone screens use the one phone frame
description: Every phone-sized screenshot or video sits inside the one phone frame component.
